description: This file contains an implementation of the CreateThingLiveCommand interface, representing an immutable command object for creating a 'Thing' in a live system context, including methods for accessing the thing's ID, the thing itself, setting headers, and generating responses.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of CreateThingLiveCommand, encapsulating the logic to create and modify 'Thing' objects in a live commands context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of CreateThingLiveCommand from a generic Command object, casting it to CreateThing.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID of the 'Thing', or null if not present.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command by creating a new command instance with the provided headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new answer builder for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this command for debugging.
